subject: Mythology
title: Democracy Born from Myth
description: One-minute skill: Democracy Born from Myth.

hook.text: Greek mythology shaped Greek politics. Their myths about justice directly inspired democratic ideals.

buildup.text: Athena represented wisdom and fair judgment. Her city Athens became the world's first democracy.

discovery.text: The myth of Prometheus — defying authority for humanity's good — became a model for political rebellion.

twist.text: Even the idea of 'hubris' as a political crime came from myths about mortals who defied the gods.

climax.text: The U.S. founders filled their buildings with Greek columns and named their Senate after Roman tradition.

punchline.text: Modern democracy was built on stories told around Greek fires.

quiz.question: Which Greek myth became a model for political rebellion?
options: The story of Narcissus and self-reflection
The story of Prometheus defying authority for humanity
The story of Odysseus returning to Ithaca
